messages:
alex_cs: Quick capture from three recent handoffs. Dropping raw quotes + suggested triage. Please triage into quick fix vs investigate vs roadmap.

- Solace Retail (SMB): asks for a "snooze route" feature so test routes don't appear on CSV exports. Quote: "Our month-end needs a clean ledger; test noise creates manual work."
- Meridian Capital (Pilot): reports that after POSTing embeddings the search still surfaces old docs until they manually trigger a reindex. They asked if we can emit a completion webhook.
- Nimbus Apps (PLG): found Dedicated trial modal unclear about when charges start; they expected an estimate before accepting.

Link to notes: drive/onboard/handovers-q2.csv (shared).

mina_pm: Thanks Alex. Quick Qs: Meridian webhook  what payload shape? Is reindex immediate after upsert or separate job? For Solace, what CSV columns do they expect filtered?

alex_cs: Meridian suggested a webhook like:
```
POST https://hooks.meridian.example.com/upsert-done
{
  "route": "eu-west-1",
  "job_id": "u-42",
  "status": "completed",
  "updated": 55,
  "ts": "2025-06-10T11:22:33Z"
}
```
They said they poll every 15s and often surface stale search results.

ryan_eng: Two notes: 1) webhook generator + subscription management is feasible but needs delivery guarantees and retry/backoff. 2) stale search after upsert could be indexer eventual consistency or cache TTL; need a minimal repro with timestamps. I'll attempt a repro in sandbox using their payload. ETA EOD.

emma_fin: For Solace CSV, they want columns: date, route_id, route_name, usage_tokens, cost_usd, billing_tag. The "snooze" should mark a route with billing_tag="test" and be excluded by default from the exported CSV. Finance confirms this filters reconciliation pain without changing charging.

mina_pm: Proposed triage lanes:
- Quick fix (1 sprint): add "snooze/test route" toggle in billing UI + Dedicated trial copy tweak (show estimate).
- Investigate (sprint): webhook delivery + index-consistency repro + add metric (upsert->search lag).
- Roadmap (Q3): per-route billing drilldown with downloadable per-route ledger and webhook subscription UI.

alex_cs: Marking Meridian as renewal-watch (med) until webhook or repro shows no loss. I'll surface to AE.

deploybot: Tip: use `/create_issue quick "snooze-route-export"` to spin up a prefilled ticket.

alex_cs: Created quick issue for snooze feature and attached customer quote + sample CSV. Link: https://gh/repo/issues/100901. Created infra issue for webhook + repro request: https://gh/repo/issues/100902.

ryan_eng: Repro attempt scheduled now. If reproducible, will attach minimal test and escalate. If not, we'll request exact timestamps and enable debug logs from Meridian.

mina_pm: Emma, can finance confirm the CSV column order so we present the export UI accordingly?

emma_fin: Confirmed order and included billing_tag. Also requested an optional export filter for "exclude test routes".

alex_cs: I'll draft a two-line enablement blurb for CSMs on the snooze behavior and Dedicated estimate messaging and post to Confluence tomorrow. Closing loop until repro results.
